effect: The core is on flight cooling and the chapter's goal is complete.
reaction: A reassuring completion, though I wanted a little more detail about the transfer and the object being protected.

mostWorthwhile.text: Packing the body-bearing core into the prepared carrier connected the long effort to preserve the surrounding ice with the return journey. The practical sequence made sense.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the case on the bench was a bare setup action with no detail, and the packing result was similarly terse for a consequential moment.

surprise.text: Nothing in this chapter particularly surprised me; the conditioned carrier and flight cooling followed the setup.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless: cooling, positioning, packing and placing the core all fit the goal. The bench placement felt procedural rather than a meaningful decision.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see the discovery's journey and what can be learned from it, although this short chapter's actions alone were mostly predictable.
